result:
The 5-second title card is in `s1/index.html`, and `npx hyperframes check s1 --json` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings. I haven't rendered the video or looked at any frames.

- **Headline:** "Girth" fades in and rises 60 px starting at 0 s, reaching full opacity at 1 s. It starts at 20% opacity rather than 0, because a fully empty first frame triggered a `first_frame_empty` warning.
- **Subtitle:** "Just-in-time skills" follows, fading and rising 40 px from 1.2 s to 2 s.
- **Rest of the card:** a slow 3% zoom runs from 2.2 s to the end, so the last 3 seconds aren't a dead hold.
- **Look:** 1920×1080 on a dark radial background, in the bundled Inter font.

The first check flagged two warnings about the title and subtitle being nested inside timed wrapper divs. I removed the wrappers, so the two lines are plain elements animated by the timeline. They aren't separate timed clips.

I also created `.claude/skills/girth-hyperframes`, a short HyperFrames conventions skill I distilled from the installed `hyperframes` and `hyperframes-cli` skills. It's in the project, not in `s1/`. I didn't do Girth's sharing-consent step, since this session isn't interactive.
